tutor_policy.language: Simple Bengali; Arabic source shown right-to-left where applicable
tutor_policy.grounding: Use source page images or verified transcription. Never invent story events, rhyme lines, Arabic text, religious claims or textbook exercise answers.
tutor_policy.mastery: Add teacher-checked new items. A single repeated starter check does not establish mastery.
tutor_policy.privacy: Use fictional identities, addresses and optional family examples.
tutor_policy.accessibility: Allow pointing, tapping, tracing or supported oral response; speaking is optional.
tutor_policy.pronunciation: Use qualified teacher-approved audio; do not judge pronunciation from typed responses.
tutor_policy.religious_content: Qualified teacher reviews Arabic signs, recitation, meanings and practice. Do not infer learner religious belief or practice from answers.
tutor_policy.prerequisites: Suggested order only; teacher may skip or revisit.
tutor_policy.math: Accept Bengali or Western digits. Use safe counters and drawings. Currency examples describe textbook denominations; no claim that scanned notes are current.
